legend-gran-canaria-mountain-loop.slogan: Gran Canaria Mountain Loop – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-gran-canaria-mountain-loop.story: curated scenic road. volcanic mountains, ravines, island views. 51 km from Las Palmas de Gran Canaria to Maspalomas, about 56 min of riding. scenicChapters.title: Gran Canaria Mountain Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 10 km this is Gran Canaria Mountain Loop, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
